gaps.lead: I rarely drink coffee in the evening.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to something = (not) accustomed to it.

gaps.lead: 'I never wrote that review,' the chef insisted.
The exam regulations forbid the use of mobile phones.
The rescue team managed to reach the village by helicopter.
gaps.sentence: The rescue team ___ the village by helicopter.
gaps.explanation: manage to do = succeed IN doing.

gaps.lead: We couldn't go out because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: 'Couldn't go because of' → 'were prevented from going'.

gaps.lead: She'll be on a flight, so she can't join the call.
gaps.sentence: She'll be on a flight, so ___ join the call.
gaps.explanation: won't be able to = future inability.
